author: xamaks

title: BEWARE: YOU MAY LOSE ALL YOUR PROGRESS
body:
BEWARE: YOU MAY LOSE ALL YOUR PROGRESS

I have been using habitify for about a year and I am shocked at how such a simple thing as logging your habits can be so unreliable. For one of the habits that I have been tracking, my entire log history was messed up at least 3 times. I could tell because I have been sticking to that habit every single day, and I know for a fact that I had logged it on all of those days. However, when I opened the app, the habit log history turned into a mess of logged and skipped days with no obvious pattern. Other time when I changed time zones, it caused the history to get messed up too. And if you had a habit with some days failed and some successful, perhaps you wouldn’t have even noticed.

There were other bugs as well, but I am not even going to go into details.

title: What a great app! It is so thought out!
body:
It helps me so much to modify my life as I want it to be, that it may be said that it helps me to create a new version of me! 😃 

However, there are two features that I would like the most to be added to this app:
1. Either the expanded set of icons that one can attach to a particular habit, or—even better—the ability to upload user’s own images as icons 🎨 
2. More flexibility with the choice of time intervals. For example, I cannot make some habit to repeat with more interval than seven days, and it is frustrating. I hope that it is not hard to improve the app in such a way that a user could choose whatever time interval he or she prefers 🙏🏻

title: About the lasts updates
body:
Well, I’m using the app from January 2020, and it helps me to keep my routine - clean and steady. And I’ve bought the app as I liked it so much, and want to use it for my work too. I recommend the app to my friends, and even write a post about the app.

But the last update with steaks is made me very disappointed and angry.

I have some habits which related to my work and they’re are only on weekdays. Also I have habit which is repeated each Monday, Wednesday and Friday. And now I can’t use such habits as it will not be counted as habit because I’m not doing it on daily basis. And the support suggests me to use skip to “make the vision” of progress to be in steak.  The new idea of such steak was explained “they want to encourage people to create habits on daily basic.”

Well, strange idea. So why you’ve left the repeat section when you create habit? Why you’ve left the skip button which allows you to save your progress while actually you don’t do it?
